method: After freezing the final pair, returned to the programme and faculty regulations, the current course-planner entries and programme thesis guidance. Recomputed credit and level totals, checked the order of choices and formal entry conditions, then reconsidered the current UCR workbook evidence and audience content.
findings: The 180 EC programme has a 120 EC major and 60 EC of profiling. Eight required 7.5 EC foundation courses make the first year. Academic writing, Information Science, CIW Lab and the thesis add 30 EC. A four-course 30 EC deepening package completes the major. All package courses and the Lab and thesis are level 3, meeting the 45 EC major minimum. The target does not name a package. The first-listed Media, Data and Society package therefore supplies the neutral comparator, independent of UCR fit. The other three packages are considered as official interest directions. Profiling includes a coherent 30 EC minor, approved study abroad or second CIW package, or an exceptional approved combination. At least 15 profiling EC must be level 2 or 3. Other profiling choices remain open subject to approval and overlap rules, and at most 15 EC of internship count.

The general first-year binding study advice threshold is 45 EC, subject to the faculty procedures and exceptions. Required foundational courses occupy periods one to four. Academic writing and information science are listed in periods one and two. The four selected advanced package courses run in order in periods one to four. Complete the eight foundational courses and at least three of the four package courses before CIW Lab. Lab is offered in period one or three and prepares a research design and proposal. The 7.5 EC thesis follows in period two or four. Current thesis entry requires 120 EC, the eight foundations, at least three package courses and successful completion of Lab. The catalogue also lists alternative formal gates referencing legacy course codes, which are outside the current cohort plan. The student registers for the thesis group corresponding to the package. Two assessors evaluate the work and must approve the proposal, with one revision permitted. The final work is an individual small-scale empirical study and report. All research stages and registration conditions sit within the stated course credits.

The package courses, CIW Lab and thesis supply the required 45 advanced major EC. The published requirements show an individual empirical thesis after separate Lab preparation. The UCR systematic-review course supports evidence appraisal but cannot replace this preparation. Data visualisation has a genuine but partial relationship with Utrecht infographics, whereas computer vision addresses different technical problems. Language technology concerns natural-language AI and its societal effects, so AI Ethics supplies a closer partial counterpart than the psycholinguistics course alone. Negotiation contributes actual organisational interaction. The three 24-course UCR options address different questions and all pass current offering and prerequisite rules.
